bespoke_clusters.rule_of_thumb_mnemonic: ACSM guidelines recommend consuming 16 to 20 fluid ounces of water 2 hours before exercise and 7 to 10 ounces every 15 minutes during activity.
core_mechanism_bullets: ACSM guidelines recommend consuming 16 to 20 fluid ounces of water 2 hours before exercise and 7 to 10 ounces every 15 minutes during activity.
Dynamic warm-ups (leg swings, A-skips, high knees) raise muscle temperature by 2 to 3 degrees Fahrenheit without reducing peak sprint power.
bespoke_clusters.worked_field_example: An athlete losing 1.5 pounds of body mass during a 60-minute track session must drink 24 fluid ounces (16 to 24 oz per pound lost) to restore hydration.

bespoke_clusters.rule_of_thumb_mnemonic: Maximum heart rate estimates at 220 minus age in years, with aerobic conditioning targeting 60 to 80 percent of heart rate reserve.
core_mechanism_bullets: Maximum heart rate estimates at 220 minus age in years, with aerobic conditioning targeting 60 to 80 percent of heart rate reserve.
Progressive overload limits weekly training mileage or resistance volume increases to 10 percent per week to prevent stress fractures.
bespoke_clusters.worked_field_example: For a 15-year-old Scout with a 65 bpm resting pulse, 70 percent Karvonen heart rate reserve equals ((205 - 65) x 0.70) + 65, or 163 beats per minute.
bespoke_clusters.counselor_tabletop_demo: Palpate the radial pulse at the wrist for 15 seconds, multiply by 4 for resting bpm, and calculate the 60 to 80 percent aerobic training zone.

core_mechanism_bullets: Crouch start block pedals set at 45 degrees in front (2 foot-lengths behind the line) and 55 degrees in back (3 foot-lengths back).
Long jump and shot put distances measure perpendicularly from the nearest landing mark in the sand or sector back to the takeoff board inner edge.
bespoke_clusters.worked_field_example: If a long jumper's feet land at 5.10 meters but their hand touches the sand behind their hips at 4.85 meters, the official USATF mark is 4.85 meters.
bespoke_clusters.counselor_tabletop_demo: Set up a tape-line takeoff board on the floor to demonstrate proper crouch-start block spacing and zero-end steel tape measurement of a standing jump.
